blocks.html:
An audit log: one action, who performed it, on which resource, and how it ended.
Audit logs are only inserted and read, never updated or deleted.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the audit log, prefixed with `audlog_`.

types.name: started_at
types.description: When the action started, such as when the request arrived.

types.name: ended_at
types.description: When the action ended, such as when the response was sent.

types.name: actor_type
types.description: The type of actor that performed the action.

types.name: actor_id
types.description: The ID of the user, API key, or customer that performed the action.

types.name: impersonator_id
types.description: The ID of the Medusa staff member acting as the actor, on Medusa Cloud.

types.name: action
types.description: The name of the action, such as `order.cancel` or `POST /admin/orders/:id/cancel`.

types.name: resource_type
types.description: The type of resource acted on, such as `order`.

types.name: resource_id
types.description: The ID of the resource acted on. `null` when the action acts on several resources.

types.name: request
types.description: The HTTP details. `null` for an audit log written outside an API request.

children.name: path
children.description: The request path without the query string.

children.name: request_id
children.description: The request ID, the same one that appears in the application logs.

types.name: request_data
types.description: The request fields that the route chose to keep.

types.name: response_data
types.description: The response fields that the route chose to keep.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Any other data attached to the audit log.
